content:
Dana Li: Quick alert - APAC hosted inference seeing elevated 5xxs and token errors starting ~14:20 UTC. Customer reports + internal alarms.
Omar Haddad: Looking now. Gateway shows a spike of token refresh requests; a new auth-proxy revision rolled out as canary at 14:05.
Nina Gomez: Ive paused canary traffic and started a rollback. Command: `k8s-rollout undo svc/auth-proxy --to-revision=42`.
oncall-bot: alert: apac-hosted: 5xx-rate 6.7% (5m window) - paging oncall.
Dana Li: Mitigations in flight: pause canary, rollback, enable token-cache fail-open for 5m. CS notified; prepping status page.
Omar Haddad: Rollback in progress. CPU on two proxy pods was at 95%, likely token-thundering. Scaling those pods down.
Nina Gomez: Rollback complete. 5xx rate falling to ~0.8% in ap-sg region. Latency returning to baseline.
status-bot: statuspage draft: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/ghi789 - impact: partial outage APAC hosted inference.
Dana Li: Root cause hypothesis: regression in canary that removes jitter from refresh, causing synchronized refresh storms when backend returns intermittent 401s.
Omar Haddad: Short-term follow-ups: add client jitter (owner: Omar), add proxy-side backoff and limiters (owner: Nina), add canary auth smoke test (owner: Dana).
Dana Li: Postmortem ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4535. We'll post a detailed timeline after triage.
oncall-bot: incident status: mitigated - monitoring.
Nina Gomez: Sent DMs to top impacted customers and CS. Closing thread unless we see regression. :thumbsup:
